items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: even I did a lot of stuff with Lawrence Welk, a lot of polka albums playing tuba.

ctx.x: We were working at Billy Berg's on La Cienega and Pico, and Strayhorn brought us an arrangement for our little band, two tenors, trumpet and a rhythm section, and we played it before Duke ever even heard about it. We broadcast it, and Billy Berg played the part of the announcer, too... So Lawrence Welk gets credit for saying, "The boys will now play 'Take A Train,'" but that's not where it started. Billy Berg was the first one who said, "The boys will now play 'Take a Train'" with Lee and Lester's band, in the…
